correctness.rationale: For fixed q in (0,1), the finite parent law is geometric conditional on age <=j; a coupling differs from a stationary two-sided geometric-edge graph at finitely many edges a.s. Finite stationary degrees and finite-range monotone approximation justify Birkhoff limits for triangles and wedges. Independence of parent choices gives the exact triangle series and wedge factorial moments. Exact polynomial derivatives, Descartes sign changes and rational root intervals prove both unique and distinct maxima. The packaged verifier passed all 58 exact-rational assertions; finite tests do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: Raw triangle count and global transitivity are standard, mathematically distinct clustering invariants in the simplest non-tree independent exponential-age growth extension. The exact rational density laws and provably different sharp optima identify a natural structural trade-off; no arbitrary finite slice or unsupported downstream application is needed. This is not a claim about graphon density, multigraph multiplicity, or fluctuation universality.
